t_advice_summary_textbox.text: My goal is to find the forest which has the most mushrooms.I should use the advice given during step 1.The mushroom gnomes which i pick will lead to that particular forest.There is an option given to players to collect more mushrooms in round 5.However it is upto the individual to collect more mushroom from round 1.

vb_textbox.text: Hello! This game needs concentration and focus. My top tips that will raise your gameplay are the following:1. Write down the colours in short form e.g: Blue- b, Purple=p, etc. If two colours start with the same letter, don't worry. Just try your best.2. Focus in the middle of the screen so you can play faster and pick the colours easily.    soPurple,Brown,Yellow and Pink take you to a Dark forest and Orange, Green, Red, Blue take you to a bright forest. The amount mushrooms you get depends on these two categories:1:Luck2: If the dark forest has low amounts of mushrooms, Do pick the Dark forest gnomes for the next few rounds and the same rules apply for the bright forest.  If you seem to be getting high amounts of mushrooms, then stick with the forest.Be ready for all outcomes and good luck!
